title: OpenAI says it's "pacing model development" as AI cybersecurity risks grow too dangerous
summary: OpenAI is deliberately "pacing AI model development," partly because the upcoming "Astra" model may be close to gaining critical cyberattack capabilities. A new monitoring system triggers an alert within 30 minutes if a model shows suspicious behavior. The article OpenAI says it's "pacing model development" as AI cybersecurity risks grow too dangerous appeared first on The Decoder .
